description: Returns a paginated list of harm sources for the specified company. Harm sources identify the material, substance, or object that caused or could cause harm in an incident.

parameters.name: filters[active]
parameters.description: If true, returns item(s) with a status of 'active'.

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYY...

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort direction. Use the value to sort ascending, or prefix with a hyphen (e.g. -name) to sort descending.

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: When true, returns both active and inactive harm sources. When omitted or false, returns only active harm sources.

id.description: Unique identifier of the harm source.

name.description: Display name of the harm source, translated to the requested locale. For the untranslated original name, see name_key.

name_key.description: Untranslated original name of the harm source. Use for programmatic matching when locale-independent identification is needed.

active.description: Whether this harm source is active and available for selection when recording incidents.

global.description: Whether this harm source is a Procore-provided default. Global harm sources cannot be renamed or deleted.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this harm source was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this harm source was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.
